senses.gloss: (b. h., v. <cite ref="A03395"><he>אֵת</he></cite>) only with pronominal suffix
indicating the objective case, אוֹתִי me, אוֹתְךָ thee, &c.—2) with pronom., &c.
with pronom. suffix of third person, for emphasizing the subject, אוֹתוֹ he himself, this one, the same, he who &c.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 2:2">Gen. R. s. 2</cite>, beg. <he>ישב לו א׳ וכ׳</he> the latter now sat there confounded &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 6:1:6">Y. Git. VI, 47ᵈ</cite> <he>באותו ענין</he> on this very subject (divorce).
<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:8">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>זכור אותו האיש וכ׳</he> may that man be remembered for good.
Ber. V, 3 באוֹתָהּ שעה in that hour; a. fr.—אותו מקום euphem. for pudenda.
Git. 69ᵇ; a. e.—אותו ואת בנו the law concerning the killing of the young with its mother on the same day (Lev. XXII, 28).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:1:4">Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ</cite> top <he>א׳ שבפה</he> those laws delivered orally.
<cite ref="Ketubot 4a:1">Keth. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>כל א׳ הימים</he> all those days; a. fr. [In later writings <he>אותו האיש</he> is freq. used for Jesus of Nazareth.
